# Aquib Israr: SEO, GEO & AEO Manager

> Aquib Israr is an SEO manager and Generative/Answer Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) specialist based in Delhi NCR, India, with 6+ years of experience turning organic search into leads and revenue. This site is his interactive portfolio, including a free live SEO checkup tool.

## Key facts
- Current role: Assistant Manager, SEO at UDIT (formerly IIAD), Gurugram. Leads SEO and GEO strategy and the IIAD → UDIT domain and content migration.
- Previously: Assistant Manager, SEO at AND Academy (2025–2026). Owned an organic engine delivering ~5,000 leads, 300+ applications and ~200 enrollments a year (approx. INR 2 crore in revenue).
- Led recovery from the December 2025 Google Core Update; grew monthly impressions 86% (5.07M → 9.42M) and improved average position from 23 to 10.
- Built a GEO program from scratch that now drives about a fifth of organic conversions.
- Original research on Google AI Mode citations and ChatGPT citation behaviour; featured by PPC Land (June 2026).
- Skills: technical SEO, render-parity audits, structured data (JSON-LD), entity SEO, AI Overview / AI Mode optimisation, Search Console API, Looker Studio, Chrome extension development.
